title: Exam Readiness & Mastery Prediction Engine
description: The Exam Readiness Engine is EthioBio's first predictive educational system. It evaluates readiness for exams, topic-level risk, and intervention urgency by converting educational data into actionable academic forecasts.

userStories.title: Domain models: ExamReadinessProfile and TopicReadiness
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Pydantic models for ExamReadinessProfile (with overall_readiness, readiness_band, topic_readiness list, risk_topics list) and TopicReadiness (with topic, readiness_score, risk_level, risk_factors list, review_status), so the readiness profile has a typed contract.
acceptanceCriteria: ExamReadinessProfile has fields: user_id (UUID), generated_at (datetime), overall_readiness (float 0-100), readiness_band (str), topic_readiness (list[TopicReadiness]), risk_topics (list[str])
TopicReadiness has fields: topic (str), readiness_score (float 0-100), risk_level (str: LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/CRITICAL), risk_factors (list[str]), review_status (str: current/overdue)
All models are Pydantic BaseModel classes
Models live in src/core/learning_intelligence/readiness/models/readiness_profile.py
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: ReadinessService: readiness calculation and risk analysis
userStories.description: As a developer, I want ReadinessService that consumes LearnerSnapshot, computes per-topic readiness (from mastery average_score), determines risk_factors (overdue_review, active_misconception, low_ability via boolean checks), derives risk_level from factor count, assigns readiness_band from score range, and returns ExamReadinessProfile.
acceptanceCriteria: ReadinessService.get_readiness(user_id) returns ExamReadinessProfile
Calls SnapshotService.get_snapshot(user_id) as data source
Per-topic readiness_score = mastery_by_topic average_score (defaults to 50 if no mastery data)
Risk factor 'overdue_review' set when due_reviews has items with next_review_at < now
Risk factor 'active_misconception' set when misconceptions has any with frequency >= 3
Risk factor 'low_ability' set when ability_by_topic shows ability_score < 0.3 or uncertainty > 2.0
risk_level: LOW (0 factors), MODERATE (1 factor), HIGH (2 factors), CRITICAL (3+ factors)
readiness_band: Critical (0-39), Developing (40-59), Ready (60-79), Strong (80-100)
review_status: 'overdue' if overdue_review is active, else 'current'
risk_topics = topics where risk_level is HIGH or CRITICAL
overall_readiness = average of all topic readiness_scores
Service is a single class at src/core/learning_intelligence/readiness/readiness_service.py
Empty state: when snapshot has no mastery data, returns profile with overall_readiness=0, readiness_band='Critical', empty topic list, no risk topics
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Exam Readiness API endpoint and router
userStories.description: As a developer, I want GET /intelligence/readiness/{user_id} that returns an ExamReadinessProfile, registered in the app, so the dashboard can display readiness data.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /intelligence/readiness/{user_id} returns ExamReadinessProfile JSON
Response has: overall_readiness, readiness_band, topic_readiness (list), risk_topics (list)
Router lives at src/api/intelligence/readiness_router.py or is added to existing intelligence router
Router is imported and app.include_router'd in src/main.py
/intelligence/:path* rewrite already exists in dashboard/next.config.js from previous work
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: ExamReadinessCard dashboard widget on student detail page
userStories.description: As a student, I want to see an Exam Readiness overview card on my dashboard that shows my overall readiness score, readiness band, and risk topics, so I know how prepared I am for exams.
acceptanceCriteria: ExamReadinessCard component fetches from /intelligence/readiness/{userId}
Displays overall_readiness as a large percentage with colored readiness band badge
Lists risk_topics with risk_level indicators
Shows count of topics evaluated
Empty state: 'No readiness data yet — take quizzes to assess your readiness'
Loading skeleton shown during fetch
Error state: 'Unable to load readiness data' with retry button
Component placed in dashboard/src/components/learning/ExamReadinessCard.tsx
Imported and rendered in dashboard/src/app/students/[id]/page.tsx below ContinueLearningFeed
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using Playwright browser tools
userStories.notes: Browser verification not performed: Playwright Chrome not available in environment. Manual verification needed.

userStories.title: Telegram proactive reminder script
userStories.description: As a student, I want daily Telegram reminders about my due reviews and recovery tasks, so I stay on track without opening the app.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/send_proactive_reminders.py exists following send_digests.py pattern
Script queries SpacedRepetitionSchedule for due reviews per user
Script queries RecoveryPlan for active plans with pending tasks
Script uses existing bot.send_message to push reminder to each user
Users without telegram_id are skipped gracefully
Message format: 'You have X reviews due today.' + recovery progress if applicable
Script is idempotent and safe to run multiple times
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
